title: Local resident named International President of Women's Clubs - NewsBreak
text:
18 hours ago
WASHINGTON, DC — The General Federation of Women's Clubs recently installed Wendy Carriker of Mount Airy as its 56th International President.
The installation took place during the 2026 Annual Convention, held June 26–29 at the Scottsdale Westin Kierland Resort & Spa.
"A dedicated clubwoman since 1985, Carriker has served General Federation of Women's Clubs in a succession of all executive committee roles, most recently as president-elect under the 2024–2026 administration of International President Suellen B. Brazil," club officials said.
At the state level, she served the North Carolina club as director of Junior Clubs from 2000 to 2002 and as state president from 2012–2014, during which member clubs surpassed a goal of 500,000 meals for food-insecure children — ultimately providing more than 17 million meals through partnerships with No Kid Hungry and Feeding America.
Beyond her federation service, Carriker spent 28 years on the Mount Airy City Schools Board of Education, serving as chairman from 2004 to 2018, and has owned two small businesses since the late 1970s. She and her husband Chip have been married since 1977 and have two daughters and three grandsons.
Under her administration, Carriker will lead a board of directors composed of region presidents, state/district of Columbia Federation Presidents, directors of Junior Clubs, committee chairmen, and appointees representing more than 60,000 members in affiliated clubs across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, and more than a dozen countries.
